description: Calibration thresholds for interpreting raw manipulation scores. Derived from benchmark evaluation.

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.description: Minimal or no manipulation detected. Content is factual and objective.

mild.label: Mild Manipulation
mild.description: Some persuasive language present, but not strongly manipulative.

moderate.label: Noticeable Manipulation
moderate.description: Clear manipulation tactics detected. Reader should evaluate critically.

strong.label: Strong Manipulation
strong.description: Multiple strong manipulation tactics. High risk of misleading the reader.

extreme.label: Extreme Manipulation
extreme.description: Extreme manipulation with multiple concurrent high-risk tactics. Avoid or fact-check rigorously.

capsBonus.description: Bonus score per all-caps word (shouting effect)

exclamationBonus.description: Bonus score per exclamation mark (emotional intensity)

densityNormalization.description: Weight per-word to normalize long vs short texts

benchmarkStats.note: Run GET /api/evaluation?recalculate=true to populate these fields
